data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
(Support task — DD ownership is implicit via task-3 which provides the executable that the Closure Checks section references.)

Append a `## Closure Checks` section to the description of epic ticket a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 listing the two durable end-state intents:

  1. At least one bug from the a34c sprint carries a valid detected_by:<channel> tag from the seven allowed values (tests, review-llm, review-human, production, user-report, internal-dogfood, other).
  2. calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture=tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs returns exit 0 with a non-empty bugs-by-channel section.

Also add an inline note: 'Sprint Phase-I orchestrator invokes plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh and pipes its stdout to plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh before epic close. No project_closure_hooks registration — preserves default SC9/SC13/SC14 gate path for other epics.'

Use the ticket CLI to update the description. Do not edit .tickets-tracker/ events directly.

## Testing Mode
GREEN — no RED test needed for a pure ticket description edit.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Epic ticket description contains a ## Closure Checks heading — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | jq -r '.description' | grep -q '## Closure Checks'
- Closure check #1 (detected_by tag on a real sprint bug) is listed — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | jq -r '.description' | grep -Eq 'detected_by.*seven allowed|detected_by.*tag'
- Closure check #2 (calibration-report fixture run) is listed — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | jq -r '.description' | grep -q 'calibration-report.sh monthly --fixture=tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs'
- Inline note references check-a34c-closure.sh — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso ticket show a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 | jq -r '.description' | grep -q 'plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh'
- project_closure_hooks remains unregistered — Verify: ! grep -q '^project_closure_hooks' .claude/dso-config.conf

## File Impact
- Epic ticket a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 description — Edit via ticket CLI
data.title: Add ## Closure Checks section to epic a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 referencing check-a34c-closure.sh
